_comment: LoopStar cycle names (Phase WM). Maps a METRE + its GROUPING to the name musicians actually use. The binary carries NO names -- with this file absent the menu shows only derived numbers ('7/8 . 2+2+3'), which is the RULE #1 posture: no tradition vocabulary compiled into the app. Correcting or adding a name is a PR here, zero rebuild.
_grouping_caveat: `groups` MUST match what LoopStarMaterialEngine.meterGroups currently generates, or the name will not attach. Several traditional groupings differ from the engine default and are listed under `unmatched` below -- they need the WM.1 grouping override before they can be named.

unmatched._comment: Real named cycles whose traditional grouping the engine does not currently produce. Naming them today would mislabel a different rhythm. They arrive with the WM.1 grouping override.

lesnoto-7.note: reachable today via meterGroups(rotation:), which nothing persists yet

_denominator_caveat: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-23 by the per-cycle `pulseUnit` field. The binary's LoopStarConductor.meterDenominator now consults this registry first and only falls back to its hardcoded 6-or-7-means-eighths rule when no cycle declares one. Declaring pulseUnit changes the CLOCK for that metre (clockBPM = packBPM * pulseUnit / 4), so a 9 declared as /8 has a bar half as long as a 9 left at /4 -- correct for a slip jig, and the reason it could not be named before.
